STATUS: PARTIAL / NOT_READY. Source only; all technical checks UNRUN. This Builder
has executed ZERO hashes, generators, imports, parsers or tests. No runtime
authority or mathematical result is issued by this report.

## Exact scope and files

  derivation, exact prefix/prelude edits, static/helper cost inventory and immutable
  grammar/scalar suffix lineage; separate fixed alias-retention derivative.
- scripts/test/admit-private-summary-tip081-p3.mjs — normal and dedicated
  negative-control exact tuples, both NOT_ISSUED; fixed zero-argument loaders;
  primitive-text artifact denial before import.

  source cut before deriver import; complete first emitted cut; fixed36 named
  predecessor preservation; six create-only derived artifacts.

  focused-harness-type/unit commands, hard process-group deadlines and bounded
  raw output; complete reviewed/issued input cut before any check/import.

Producer/lifecycle and verifier source belong to other Builders. No P2 file, old
test/config, installed parser, real-v2 codec or existing artifact is changed here.
The new hand-authored source may still receive within-contract pre-effect fixes;
Main must stop edits and capture the complete exact reviewed versions before use.

## Derivation and admission premises

Only the accepted checked-P2 three-file tuple is a derivation input. Exact sizes
and SHA256 pins are copied from P2_GRAMMAR_COMPLETION, not caller data. The tool
reads these as TEXT on fixed no-follow descriptors, verifies the tuple, matches
the unique initialize seam and exact old two-line cost prelude. It never imports
or invokes installed Acorn. TypeScript is used by Main only to parse TOOL SOURCE.
Its fixed library/package size/hash tuple is verified before dynamic deriver
import, separately from the36 preservation rows. Strict captured fatal UTF8
decoding preserves BOM and rejects malformed tool bytes rather than reconstructing
replacement text. The fixed fileURL import relies on Main's serial stopped-editing
process protocol, not a claim of hostile global filesystem isolation.

Edits remove the four P2 exports and old observation, replace only P2 reserve and
disposal bodies, explicitly assign each inherited reserve call to C03's named
family, and append the independently owned lexical P3 bodies. Mixed dictionary/
string costs are split before the original operation with node/entry counters
charged once. Unknown mapping/constructor/re-entry remains OPEN and refuses tool
output; reviewers must inspect the complete known mapping before generation.

The scalar/grammar initializer suffix is unchanged byte-for-byte. New inventories
bind the full frozen parent map/hash and explicit UTF16 offset delta rather than
silently pretending old spans describe new prefix coordinates. The fixed alias
fault replaces only `state.producerRoot = null; // P3_ALIAS_CLEAR` with retention.
Its separate profile/domain/tuple is rejected by normal admission. It exercises
ALIAS_REFUSED in the legitimately advanced phase, not premature-phase denial.

Compile release stays false in Builder source. Main must independently review
every emitted delta, issue the reviewed compile release/tuple, and capture that
exact source before imports. Profile/inventory UNRUN/NOT_ISSUED capture flags are
history, never authority. Exact issued loader source pins are authoritative for
this synthetic lane only. There is no caller-selected hash/path/URL/fault input.

## Source-derived cost deliverable

The deriver enumerates every final fixed literal/property key, top-level binding,
ordinary function/prototype, bound capture, weak header and module array backing.
Object own-field schema fees and literal null-prototype syntax fees are separate.
The exact captured TextDecoder constructor has the reviewed utf-8/null-prototype/
fatal:true/ignoreBOM:true shape, context4096; no generic native-constructor fallback.
Explicit before-operation bootstrap descriptor/sanitization debits are not charged
again as static pool sites. These are logical conventions, not RSS/VM estimates.

C02 has separate domains: inherited P2 helper segment keeps its accepted2*129
coexistence premise; NEW P3 helpers have itemized actual locals/parameters and a
complete direct call graph. Both new traversals/decoder are iterative. Direct
cycles refuse inventory; each new helper frame is charged once only under the
independently reviewed acyclic/no-dynamic-callback/no-returning-P2-re-entry premise.
Native captured primitives/shared grammar remain declared common-mode dependencies.
No all-helper258 multiplier or anonymous whole-function reserve is introduced.

The final concrete C00/C01/C02 numbers and reserve occurrence inventory are UNRUN
until Main's reviewed derivation effect. Source claims are not measured output or
coverage proof. C03 families, C04 frames/sites/node reads/array edges/bindings,
C07–C09 pure-SHA/codec/metadata capacities and C10 transfers remain the exact
frozen contract's source-review obligations. No cost is lowered to force fitting.

# P3 implementation contract — pre-code freeze

2026-10-08 · SAME081D8 · Owner approved revision2 P3, R1–R8/P301–P336.
Main settles within-contract details here. Product code waits for independent
design CLEAR. This is synthetic-only; predecessor P2 and real v2 are frozen.

## Exact public operations and lifecycle

## Exact data wire and syntax taxonomy

Version1; purpose TIP081_P3_SYNTHETIC_SYNTAX_SUMMARY. Top-level keys in the
following exact order, no extensions:
version,purpose,mode,profile,syntheticUtf16Hash,utf16Units,astOccurrences,
grammarAttempts,sites,ledger,summaryHash.
profile=P3_ECMA15_FIXED19_COMMON_GRAMMAR. Hashes64 lowercase hex.
syntheticUtf16Hash=SHA256 of exact little-endian16-bit code units, including lone
surrogates, no normalization/replacement. It is NOT authentic UTF8 sourceHash.
summaryHash=SHA256 of ASCII canonical JSON body omitting only summaryHash, then
append summaryHash last. Arrays preserve canonical order, integers shortest decimal
U excluding -0/unsafe/fractional. No raw source/name/specifier/AST/path export.

Site exact field order: kind,start,end,binding,loader,conditional,optional,computed,
status. kind IMPORT/EXPORT/DYNAMIC_IMPORT/CALL/NEW/MEMBER. Emit every corresponding
AST occurrence, including ExportNamed/Default/All, not just source-bearing exports.
Canonical ascending (start,end,kind ordinal above), stable per-occurrence order for
equal tuples. Shared shorthand AST nodes count per reachable edge; grammarAttempts
is separate attempted allocation count including tentative work.
start/end are source UTF16 offsets, 0<=start<=end<=utf16Units.
binding NONE/NO_LOCAL_BINDING/LOCAL_BINDING/AMBIGUOUS; loader NONE/STATIC_LITERAL/
DYNAMIC/BARE_REQUIRE/EVAL/FUNCTION/OTHER/COMPUTED; conditional CERTAIN/
CONTROL_OR_DEFERRED/OPTIONAL. optional/computed boolean; status always OPEN.

Complete supported AST child coverage: independently authored producer/verifier
child schemas or bounded trusted-own enumeration of ALL children, with unknown
node kinds refusing before extraction acceptance. Binding collection includes
import/var/let/const/function/class/params/catch/destructuring. Conservative global
name collection MAY mark any declared reference AMBIGUOUS rather than claiming a
lexical scope proof; it must never mark a locally declared/shadowed name unbound.
For genuinely undeclared names use NO_LOCAL_BINDING, still OPEN. Function/class/
branch/loop/logical/conditional/try uncertainty propagates CONTROL_OR_DEFERRED;
optional chain propagates OPTIONAL. Bare require/eval/Function classify syntax,
not privileged authority. All unknown calls/computed/native/file resolution OPEN.
No target RegExp/BigInt or unsupported P2 syntax branch is enabled by P3.
CERTAIN means only absence of syntactic control/deferred/optional ancestors,
never guaranteed execution. NO_LOCAL_BINDING means only no syntactic declaration
in the complete conservative inventory, not an ambient loader/builtin authority.
Visits<=200000 per stage, counted per edge including reused nodes; reject a cycle
on the bounded current-ancestor path, do not globally dedup occurrences. Binding
storage<=512 names and65536 cumulative UTF16 name units per stage; exhausting it
refuses, never publishes an incomplete declaration inventory.

summaryBytes,replayReservedBytes,replayLiveBytes,scratchBytes,
unreclaimedProducerBytes,unreclaimedReplayBytes,totalBytes,peakBytes,
producerEntries,producerAttempts,siteCount.
The wire is captured at PRODUCER_SUMMARY. Verifier independently reconstructs

cost rules; wire totals/phase/seal alone never authorize success. Current metadata

## Decoder/output and cost/lifetime rows

preflight exact encoded size before decode/clone/hash. Decoder depth<=8,
objectFields<=16,arrayLength<=512,totalValues<=8192,stringUnits<=128. Site count
<=512 and inherited cumulative internal memberships+sites<=20000; byte limit may
refuse earlier. These are limits, never a truncation policy. Independent verifier
decoder/preflight/canonicalizer must not call producer equivalents. Bounded scalar
preflight validates duplicate keys/structure before native no-reviver JSON.parse.
No caller objects are reflected. Raw JSON/native errors never escape.
Wire strings are closed ASCII literals/enums/hash64 only, with no escapes or
arbitrary free text. Captured-charCode scalar preflight checks exact keys/order/
punctuation/numbers/array counts/structure before any token slice/JSON.parse/hash.
Decoded objects/arrays are null-sanitized before reads/writes; source identities
have independently authored explicit UTF16-unit streaming implementations.
